<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the dining hall.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?

A degenerate male *would* say that...
It makes no sense at all.

Since it would be wonderful if there was
one less male in this world!

Having tea with a degenerate doesn't
make me happy at all!

However...I am a bit hungry, and the food
and drinks didn't do anything wrong...

I'll join you this one time.
Just for you.

Why do degenerates always say
ridiculous things?

If you think this is funny, then you should
just bite your tongue and choke on it!
Or you should fast and die from starvation!

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Tenko looks deep in thought...
